experiment_data.hypothesis: Training with randomized (shuffled) occ labels preserves the auxiliary loss signal but destroys spatial correspondence. If CAR does not improve compared to vanilla baseline, it proves that the specific spatial content of occ labels (not just any auxiliary loss) drives the safety improvement. This validates Claim 4 (Not Any Auxiliary Loss). Seed 43 replication of ablation_random_occ_s0.
